Name: Immersive Family- A Children's Events Expansion
Author: xiaoleiwen
Description:
I made [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url], a MOD where the children will talk about your spouse and the other NPCs. But none of the NPC recognize my farmer's children in the game. So I make this new MOD.

This MOD adds [b]35 new events[/b] for your children. ([b]23 events[/b] for [b]base game[/b], [b]12 crossover events[/b]):
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]3 events require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]
[*]4 events require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿
[*]1 event requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]  (will have more content if you have [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet & Jessie[/url] [/b]and[b] [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10770]Lurking in the Dark - NPC Sen[/url]﻿[/b][/b])
[*]1 event requires[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10627?tab=description]Yri & Charles[/url][/b]
[*]2 events require[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Sterling, Mia and Henry[/url][/b]
[*]1 event requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats[/url]
[/list][/spoiler]
This mod also adds [b]340 additional dialogues[/b] for the [b]vanilla NPCs[/b] and also [b]Modded NPCs[/b] from the following :
[spoiler]
1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿
3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp
[/url]4. ES standalone npcs:
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Sterling, Mia and Henry[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10627?tab=description]Yri & Charles[/url][/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet & Jessie[/url][/b]
[*][b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10016]Lavril & Void[/url][/b][/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Mateo[/url]﻿[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437]Author, Rodney O'Brien[/url]﻿[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883]Eli and Dylan[/url]﻿[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10770]Lurking in the Dark - NPC Sen[/url]﻿[/b]
[/list]5. Other standalone npcs
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12548]Lucikiel[/url][b]﻿[/b]
[*][b][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599][b]P[/b]rofessor Jasper Thomas[/url]﻿
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22600]Barron (A New Dream)[/url]﻿[/b]
[/list][/spoiler]

*************************************

[b][u]Can be added mid-save[/u]. [/b]But the event will start from the first baby event.
[b]
Please [u]Enable the Crib[/u] (find Robin) before adding this MOD.[/b] (if you add this mod after having grown-up children)

[b]Please [u]Check the CONFIG[/u] before loading your game. You need to [u]choose how the children call you and your spouse[/u]. [/b]

[b][u]Required MODs:[/u][/b]
1) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7517]Custom Tokens[/url]
3) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[b][u]Highly Recommended MODs:[/u][/b]
1) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14377]Lasting Conversation Topics[/url] - all additional dialogues are written as Conversation Topic, so it won't replace the dialogues from the other mod, and you will not miss them if you install LCT.
2) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]Unique Children Talk[/url] - these mods allow your children to talk, and I made IUCT, some of the dialogues in IUCT and IF are related.
3) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412]Immersive Children- Portraits and Sprites[/url] - matching portraits and sprites for the [b]Portrait Version[/b].
4) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9063]SH's Wild Animals[/url] - some animal sprites from this mod have been used, you may find it more immersive if this mod is installed.

*************************************
***************NEW*****************

[b][u]For immersive family (Portrait Version) only:[/u][/b]

In the old version, the children can only talk in overhead bubble during the events. In [b]Immersive Family (Portraits Version)[/b], the children can now talk during the events using the usual dialogue box with portrait like a normal NPC. If you use the Portraits Version, please ensure that you do not install the original version.

[b][u]Please set the additional config using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] before loading your save game[/u][/b] with children. Please also note that you need to change the config ([b]state the children's names[/b]) every time loading a save game with different spouse and children:
[spoiler]
[b]BoyName[/b] - Type your son's name here.
[b]GirlName[/b] - Type your daughter's name here.
[b]UsePortraitMOD[/b]- Tick this if you are using a content patcher MOD that modifies the children's portraits during events such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412]Immersive Children- Portraits and Sprites[/url]
[/spoiler]
[b][u]How to use the portraits for children for Immersive Family (Portrait Version):
[/u][/b][spoiler]
A) If you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412]Immersive Children- Portraits and Sprites[/url], just install it following the instructions and set the config options as stated on the mod page. Please[b] tick [/b]the [b]UsePortraitMOD[/b] config option for Immersive Family.

B) If you are using combination of children's sprites MOD and compatible portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url] ([b]6 expressions[/b]) such as:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18619]Haley's Children for Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url]﻿ that matches Haley's children from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21032]Seasonal Elliott's Kids for Unique Children and Unique Children Talk[/url]﻿
[/list]- Find the portraits files in those MOD.
- [b]Duplicate and Rename[/b] the portrait files to [b]Toddler[/b] and [b]Toddler_Girl
[/b]- Please copy the portraits and paste them in the [b]assets\Portraits[/b] folder in the [b]Immersive Family MOD folder[/b]. You need to[b] replace[/b] the files there.
- Please also ensure that [b]UsePortraitMOD[/b] is [b]not ticked[/b] under config.
* Notes: Portraits mod with [b]4 expressions[/b] can be used without any bug)
[/spoiler]
If you want to consider commission artists to make matching portraits for wonderful children sprite MODs such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10411]Elaho babies[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/552]Babies Take After Spouse[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10494]Lumisteria Toddlers Like Parents[/url] etc, you may look for [b][u]Portrait Artists[/u] [/b]such as:
[spoiler]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/airyn]airyn[/url]﻿
[url=https://ko-fi.com/whitelotus]gildedrose
[/url][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilaoliu]Lilaoliu[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/74479268]fellowclown[/url]
[url=https://raffdazzeljohn.wordpress.com/]RaffieJohn[/url]﻿
[/spoiler]

[b][u]Compatibility and FAQ:
[/u][/b]
1) [b][u]Writing style:[/u][/b]
- This mod can be used for any spouse, biological or adoption, but [b]may not be compatible[/b] writing wise if:
[list]
[*]you think your spouse has a very unique way of talking and so a more generic dialogues won't suit them.
[*]your spouse should have earlier experience in raising children, so not compatible for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking for Love[/url]﻿, Olivia (SVE) etc
[*]MOD that has added own vanilla baby or toddler stages events, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url]
[/list]- Personally fully tested all events with Haley, Penny, Sam, Maru and Flor (RSV) as spouse.
- [b]Not compatible if the spouse is player (multiplayer game)[/b]

2) [b][u]Farmhouse [/u][/b]
- [b]Vanilla farmhouse[/b], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17627]Lune Farmhouse[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11762]Bigger Farmhouse Map[/url] - [b]Compatible[/b], leave the highlighted areas empty (check the modpage screenshot).
- The other [b]custom farmhouse MOD[/b], please expect clipping and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url] mod, press [b]F11[/b] during event if your farmer stuck in the wall or something.

3) [b][u]Toddler Sprite[/u][/b]
-[b] Vanilla toddler sprite[/b]- please tick the relevant option under [b]CONFIG[/b] if [b]dark skin[/b]
- [b]Custom toddler sprite[/b]:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url]﻿ is fully tested and compatible
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412]Immersive Children- Portraits and Sprites[/url] - fully compatible and comes with portraits.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10411]Elaho babies[/url]﻿ is randomly tested and should work
[*]The other CP MOD that overwrites toddler sprite should work, if it is not, please ask their author.
[*][b]Alternative Texture MOD toddler sprite[/b] - Open the folder of AT MOD used, find the boy and girl toddler sprite files that you want to use, copy and paste somewhere else, then rename to [b]Toddler[/b] and[b] Toddler_girl[/b], and finally copy and replace the files of same name in my mod folder under [b][CP] Immersive Family\assets\AT Toddlers[/b]. Remember to[b] enable AlternativeTextureToddlerSprites[/b] under [b]CONFIG[/b] before loading your save. (Limited testing, tell me if doesn't work)
[/list]- [b]Baby sprite[/b]- A temporary actor has been used due to technical limitation, let see if we can do better in 1.6.

4) [b][u] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]﻿ MOD[/u][/b]
- I don't use this mod, should work but probably will be weird in certain situation.
[list]
[*]Your main spouse only should appear in the event.
[*]Your main spouse, first and second children only should be mentioned in the dialogues.
[*][b]More than 2 children[/b], [b]2 children of same gender[/b]- [b]not compatible[/b], probably will only cause incorrect children sprite in the events
[*]These MODs will allow you to have second child before the first one turning into toddler (different from vanilla). Highly recommended to [b]only accept the second child after the first one turning into toddler[/b] if you want the events to happen at the correct timing
[/list]
5) [u][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15152]LittleNPCs[/url] and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]The Farmer's Children[/url] MOD[/b][/u]
- [b]Converted your children into real npc already[/b]- [b]not compatible[/b], not sure what will happen in the events.
-[b] Finish all the events from my mod first before adding them[/b] - should be [b]compatible

[/b]6) [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10735]Event Limiter[/url][/u]
- The baby stage events will not happen on time, but you won't miss them totally.
- You may notice the second part of certain event is not triggering, consider increasing your limit temporarily when using this mod.
[b]
[/b]7) [u][b]Multiplayer[/b][/u]
- Not supported. Not tested myself, but someone mentioned the events will always show the host's spouse.
- Not working if your spouse is a player (events involving multiple players is not a vanilla feature)

8) [u][b]Some common sense incompatible situations[/b][/u]
- Turned children into doves
- Divorced and don't have spouse
- Adopted Krobus instead of getting married and have children
